name: Tools of the Trade
summary: Horde rogues are sent from the Undercity to steal a report from Ambermill. Lord Varimathras orders them to obtain lockpicking tools and recover Kirin Tor intelligence on Dalaran’s condition.

sections.title: Eyes on Ambermill
sections.body: A prisoner’s interrogation points the Deathstalkers toward intelligence hidden in Ambermill. Silverpine Forest remains a precarious front line, and human mages guard the village’s communications fiercely. Lord Varimathras orders Deathstalker handler Mennet Carkad to direct promising operatives around the Kirin Tor sentries and recover the Dalaran Status Report.

sections.title: The Art of the Breach
sections.body: Infiltration and lockpicking test skills beyond assassination. Before entering Kirin Tor territory, operatives receive specialized thieves’ tools from Estelle Gendry. Opening the secured chest in Ambermill proves an operative can move beyond street brutality and become an espionage asset for the Forsaken.

aliases: who gives tools of the trade
faq.answer: Mennet Carkad, a Deathstalker rogue in the Undercity’s Rogues' Quarter, assigns the work. Lord Varimathras gives the order and oversees Forsaken intelligence gathering.

faq.q: What is the Dalaran Status Report?
faq.answer: The Dalaran Status Report is a sealed Kirin Tor dispatch about conditions in Dalaran. Deathstalker interrogators learned its location from a prisoner, revealing that vital information about the Forsaken’s southern neighbors was vulnerable.

aliases: where do i find the documents
faq.answer: The report is inside a locked chest at the Kirin Tor outpost of Ambermill in southern Silverpine Forest.
Estelle Gendry, an outfitter in the Undercity’s Rogues' Quarter, provides the thieves’ tools needed to open the locked chest.

faq.q: Why is Dalaran important to the Forsaken right now?
faq.answer: Dalaran’s surviving wizards are rebuilding their city across Lordamere Lake from Silverpine Forest. The Forsaken monitor the Kirin Tor to protect their holdings in Lordaeron.

faq.q: What prerequisite must be completed before taking this mission?
faq.answer: Operatives must first complete the assassination contract Fenwick Thatros, hunting a target in Silverpine Forest before Mennet Carkad trusts them with delicate infiltration work.

angles.text: As a Horde rogue, you prove your worth with formal lockpicking tools, stealth, and finesse instead of brute force.
As an undead, you help the Forsaken outwit the Kirin Tor mages who seek to reclaim Lordaeron.
As a member of the Horde, you help secure human intelligence in Silverpine and strengthen the Horde’s foothold across northern Lordaeron against Alliance remnants.
